title: Debra C NDE 3477
content: I was so excited, it was my first concert and date as a sixteen year old. Mike had invited me to a 'Styx' concert along with a group of friends. I had never drank before or did substances in my life. But, to fit in because I really liked Mike, I just followed what they were doing not knowing any type of limitation, etc. They were drinking Southern Comfort and smoking pot. So, I followed suit, not wanting to but wanted to fit in. After a while, I started feeling really sick, I could not catch my breath. I needed to get up off the bench and go for a walk trying to breathe. As Mike was walking me around the corridor behind the bleachers I all of a sudden grabbed him and yelled his name, I remember seeing his face and I could feel myself go directly down on the concrete. At the same instance, I could feel myself (my spirit) start climbing up the side of the bleachers while looking people in the face as I was going up. I started floating and looking around once again thinking 'WOW' I am still alive but I am in spirit form. I realized too that 'WOW' I was super alert. I was talking but talking through my consciousness. I could feel someone on my left side and someone on my right side. It was very calming but I could not see anyone. It's as if I knew them but not sure who but they were communicating with me through my consciousness. Once again, can't explain in words. At the same time, I can see the concert (I was high at or near the top of the roof looking down watching everything). I could hear but it was odd. As I was floating in place, colored orbs of indescribable color were coming toward me. They surrounded me with a feeling of peace and calm that is indescribable. Beautiful! Then whoever is beside me starts running through my life at a pace you cannot describe in words (like they did in with Scrooge in the Christmas story), showing bad and good. The part that got to me the most is when I was shown the pain and devastation that my leaving would cause my parents especially my mother. The cry (wailing) of my mother's voice was unbelievable. At the same time, I was looking for ways to get out of the building. I could see the attic fan as they call them spinning around at the rooftop I could get out there. I kept looking down at the doors watching a police officer at the entrance knowing when the door opened up I could float out that way but at the same time I knew I couldn't come back if I left. Everything seemed to be happening at a rate of speed that we have never experienced, it was like having full knowledge of life, at the same time whoever was next to me said I needed to make a choice. They did tell me that my mother really needed me later in life that she was not strong enough to go on without me that I needed to show her the way later on, but it was still my choice. As soon as I made the choice to stay it was like a flash like no other and I was shoved back into my body. I was mad! The weight of the body was unbelievable. When I opened my eyes, a lady paramedic was standing over me with a look on her face that was very distraught. The feeling of sickness came back; my body kept shivering for hours. Since this experience, I have a different level of consciousness, it's really strange. I have helped people before certain events occur. I have experienced things and have been able to predict before they happen by feeling. It has made a believer out of my husband, neighbor and others. It scares me sometimes knowing before things happen.

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt someone on left and right side; calming; could not see them; sensed communication through consciousness.

environment.environment_other_detail: Colored orbs of indescribable color came toward her and surrounded her.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told her her mother would need her later in life and she needed to show her the way later on.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden collapse at a concert after drinking alcohol and smoking pot for the first time; could not catch breath and felt very sick.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Colored orbs surrounded her; awareness of possible exits and that leaving meant not returning.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with viewing the concert and being surrounded by colored orbs occurred while a rapid life review was shown; boundary/choice awareness occurred during the same period.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Simultaneous observation of the concert/roof area, colored orbs, and life review/choice communication.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Colored orbs of indescribable color approached and surrounded her; she scanned for building exits (attic fan/doors) while knowing leaving meant not coming back.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “WOW I am still alive but I am in spirit form.” “Once again, can't explain in words.” “As soon as I made the choice to stay it was like a flash like no other and I was shoved back into my body. I was mad!”
